<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:i18n="clr-namespace:Stardrop.Utilities.Extension"
        x:Class="Stardrop.Views.ModNoteWindow"
        Title="{i18n:Translate ui.note_window.title}"
        Width="680" Height="460" MinWidth="400" MinHeight="270"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner" Background="{DynamicResource ThemeBackgroundBrush}"
        Icon="/Assets/icon.ico">
    <Window.Styles>
        <Style Selector="Button">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeBackgroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="Button:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ButtonHoverBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="Button:pressed /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ButtonPressedBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
        </Style>
    </Window.Styles>
    <Grid Margin="18" RowDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto">
        <TextBlock Name="modName" FontSize="16" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                   Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,12"/>
        <Border Grid.Row="1" Padding="6" BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}">
            <ContentControl Name="editorHost" HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch" VerticalContentAlignment="Stretch"/>
        </Border>
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Spacing="8" Margin="0,12,0,0">
            <Button Click="Cancel_Click" Content="{i18n:Translate internal.cancel}"/>
            <Button Click="Save_Click" FontWeight="SemiBold" Content="{i18n:Translate ui.note_window.save}"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>

<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:i18n="clr-namespace:Stardrop.Utilities.Extension"
        x:Class="Stardrop.Views.BatchCategoryWindow"
        Title="{i18n:Translate ui.batch_category.title}"
        Width="540" Height="540" MinWidth="400" MinHeight="360"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner" Background="{DynamicResource ThemeBackgroundBrush}"
        Icon="/Assets/icon.ico">
    <Window.Styles>
        <Style Selector="Button">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeBackgroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="Button:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ButtonHoverBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="Button:pressed /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ButtonPressedBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="Button:disabled /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.55"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="TreeViewItem /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_HeaderPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundHighBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="TreeViewItem:selected /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_HeaderPresenter">
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundHighBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="TreeViewItem:selected /template/ Border#PART_LayoutRoot">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource DataGridHeaderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="2,0,0,0"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="TreeViewItem:selected /template/ Border#PART_LayoutRoot:pointerover">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource DataGridHeaderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        <Style Selector="ToggleButton.ExpandCollapseChevron /template/ Path#ChevronPath">
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundHighBrush}"/>
        </Style>
    </Window.Styles>
    <Grid Margin="18" RowDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto,Auto">
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <Button Content="{i18n:Translate ui.main_window.menu_items.context.custom_category_new}" Click="Create_Click"/>
            <Button Name="renameButton" Content="{i18n:Translate ui.main_window.menu_items.context.custom_category_rename}" Click="Rename_Click"/>
            <Button Name="deleteButton" Content="{i18n:Translate ui.main_window.menu_items.context.custom_category_delete}" Click="Delete_Click"/>
        </StackPanel>
        <Border Grid.Row="1" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}" BorderThickness="1">
            <TreeView Name="categoryTree" SelectionChanged="CategoryTree_SelectionChanged"
                      Background="{DynamicResource DataGridRowBackground}"/>
        </Border>
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Name="batchOptions" Margin="0,10,0,0">
            <TextBlock Name="summaryText" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
            <CheckBox Name="includeSiblingsBox" Content="{i18n:Translate ui.batch_category.include_siblings}"
                      Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}"/>
        </StackPanel>
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="3" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Spacing="8" Margin="0,12,0,0">
            <Button Content="{i18n:Translate ui.batch_category.close}" IsCancel="True" Click="Close_Click"/>
            <Button Name="applyButton" Content="{i18n:Translate ui.batch_category.assign}" Click="Apply_Click"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>

			<ListBox Name="categoryList" Background="{DynamicResource DataGridRowBackground}" Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}" />
		</Border>
		<CheckBox Grid.Row="3" Name="includeSiblingsBox" Content="{i18n:Translate ui.batch_category.include_siblings}" Margin="0 10 0 0" Foreground="{DynamicResource ThemeForegroundBrush}" />
		<DockPanel Grid.Row="4" Margin="0 14 0 0">
			<Button Name="applyButton" i:Attached.Icon="mdi-check" HorizontalAlignment="Left" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}" Foreground="Green" Background="Transparent" />
			<Button Name="cancelButton" IsCancel="True" i:Attached.Icon="mdi-cancel" HorizontalAlignment="Right" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource HighlightBrush}" Foreground="Red" Background="Transparent" />
		</DockPanel>
	</Grid>
</Window>
